verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a dedicated Scheduled Flags feature that queues flag changes and applies them automatically at a specified future time. That is the core of this story. Release Pipelines add automated staged rollouts, but the evidence does not tie them to a specific time. missing for 10: details on what can be scheduled (segment overrides, percentage changes, multivariate weights), evidence of scheduling via the API or CLI, explicit time-based triggers for releases or pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Scheduled flags allow you to queue and automatically apply changes to feature flags at a specified future time, eliminating the need for manual intervention at the exact moment of change.
Define stages that your flags progress through automatically, with triggers and actions that control rollouts to selected environments and audiences.
